_what: Optional sources and paths. Merge the keys you want into ROOT/.container-map/container.json; every one is off (empty) by default and a source you leave empty is simply not drawn. Each "_key" line explains the key below it and is ignored by the loader.
_script_dirs: folders of scripts that belong to a planet: {"~/bin": "scripts"} homes a cron line or a running process that uses a script in ~/bin to the planet named scripts
_file_roots: extra directories the in-page file preview may read; preview only, no thread, door or verb runs there (work_root, extra_areas and planets are always readable)
_out: where the page is written; "" = ROOT/.container-map/game.html
_verbs_dir: verb manifests (<name>.json) offered as buttons; "" = ROOT/.container-map/verbs
_history_jsonl: hourly per-root snapshot used for the week-over-week storm rings; "" = ROOT/.container-map/history.jsonl
_cron_syslog_file: system log read for when each cron line last fired; "" = use the cron lines' own log mtimes
_areas_json: kinds and workers per folder; "" = areas.json next to this config, else none
_seats_json: which tmux windows may be talked to, and your other machines; "" = seats.json next to this config
_digest: a markdown log: dated lines become the ticker, lines with a decision marker go on the board
_fleet: a markdown task log; lines with a decision marker go on the board (the Today lists read the task-id format described in docs/CONFIG.md)
_decision_markers: phrases in digest/fleet lines that park a decision for you (your list replaces the default, so this is the default in full)
_reads_jsonl: read receipts for the digest (jsonl), shown beside it
_dispatch_dir: reports named d-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-<runner>.md, counted per runner
_dispatch_bin: the command the board hands items through; "" = `dispatch` on PATH
_runners_json: a runner registry ({name: {cmd, desc}}) drawn as the runners hall
_task_runs_json: where board hand-off receipts are appended (jsonl); "" = next to the tool
_tasks_json: an audit file of board items ({items: [{id, area, path, finding, verdict, who}]})
_audit_json: an auditor's verdict per board item ({items: {id: {verdict, evidence}}})
_rulings_json: your done/stale rulings on parked decisions; "" = next to the tool
_rounds_json: state file of a rounds script of yours, shown in the HUD; "" = rounds.json next to the tool (not with --root)
_synced_dir: other machines' renders (<synced_dir>/<machine>/world.json) you can cross to
_ship_machines: machines under synced_dir drawn as one snapshot ship each
_t3_state: a T3 Code state database (read-only) whose threads become ships; a list = several apps
_t3_link: the web address of that T3 server (https://host:port): a T3 thread gets an "open in T3" link; "" = none
_agent_processes: draw background `claude -p` / `codex exec` processes as ships
_pilot_log: a jsonl touch log (ts, tool, uid) from your session hook: effort badges and the trace
_tags_md: a markdown table (| `root/` | ... | **TAG** | desc |) naming each root's purpose
_today: what the Today screen reads, all off while empty: todo_md = any markdown checklist (- [ ] open, - [x] done) listed under Do today; git_dirs = git folders whose commits made today are listed as done. Agents you start on the map appear under Running now with no setting. docs/CONFIG.md lists the readers for other file formats.
